stage.name: Boss Rash
stage.spawn_type: Standard: waves approach from all four sides of the player
stage.modifiers_note: Wiki infobox fields (wiki stage id RASH; this project uses BOSSRASH). Enemy health x1.5 and it rises by +0.1 every minute with no cap. Hyper mode (+50% gold, +10% luck, 60 starting spawns, x1.25 enemy min, x1.15 projectile speed) not needed. Challenge stage, unlocked by unlocking hyper mode on all 5 normal stages.
stage.enemy_cap_rule: Periodic spawning stops while 300 or more enemies are alive; only bosses and map-event enemies can still spawn (Map event page).
stage.spawn_rule: Each minute's wave has a minimum enemy count and a spawn interval. If alive count < minimum, spawn until the quota is filled; otherwise spawn one of each enemy type in the wave per interval. Bosses are teleported back onto screen rather than despawned.
stage.map_event_chance_rule: Event chance is divided by player Luck (chanceWithLuck = eventChance / totalLuck); evaluated per repeat; no chance or 0 means guaranteed.

relics.position: center of the arena at 7:00, only if the Yellow Sign was obtained

stage_items.note: All passives (except Torrona's Box, Parm Aegis, Karoma's Mana), the 4 secret passives, 2 Floor Chickens, 2 Orologions, 1 Nduja Fritta Tanto and 1 Rosary lie outside the arena and are unreachable without Mad Groove; ignored.

stage.destructibles: Light sources (drop random pickups); destructible chance 10% (max 50%), max 5.
stage.pressure_plates: Two round pressure plates spawn every 30 s mark until 9:30. Blue (hourglass) fast-forwards to the start of the next minute; red (skull) respawns the current wave's bosses (Arcana-holder bosses do not respawn). Plates vanish at the start of the next minute if untriggered.

layout.size_note: Single enclosed arena (size not stated on the wiki).
layout.obstacles: None stated; open arena floor with two pressure plates spawning every 30 s until 9:30.
layout.theme: Boss-arena/circus style stage (the monsters want entertainment) built from recycled assets of the base stages.
layout.special_mechanics: Two pressure plates every 30 s until 9:30: blue = skip to next minute, red = respawn the current wave's bosses (not Arcana holders). Enemy health x1.5 plus +0.1 per minute, uncapped. Boss waves from Mad Forest, Inlaid Library, Dairy Plant, Gallo Tower, Cappella Magna and Moongolow; the mob pool has minimum 1 enemy (20 from 12:00). Arcana bosses at 5:00 and 10:00.

waves.notes: Bosses appear at the start of each minute; the wiki wave table gives enemy minimum 1 and interval 1.0 s (minimum 20 from 12:00).
Giant Goat-Horned Shooter is an Arcana holder: spawns only if Arcanas are enabled; its chest only awards an Arcana.
Wiki lists no regular enemies at 10:00. Elite Reaper Trainee is an Arcana holder (chest only awards an Arcana); TRAINEE_ANY used as an approximate id.
Pool 'Massive Golem' x2 = the LV29 Big Golem variants (BOSS_XLGOLEM*_29 in the Dairy Plant file); the bosses are the two Big Golems.
Giant Mimic x3: BOSS_GIANT_MIMIC1 listed three times.
Reaper at 15:00; all enemies on screen are cleared; another Reaper per minute after.

unsupported_events_note: All Boss Rash map events map to existing EVENT_KIND kinds (bat_swarm, skull_swarm, ghost_swarm, jellyfish_swarm, dragon_swarm). The wiki delay and repeat fields are ambiguous: the first delay is taken as an offset from the minute start ('at'), repeat as a count with the delay as spacing (bat swarm 1:15 x2 every 15 s; ghost swarm 5:01 x2 every 1.2 s; dragon swarm second row 8:02 x10 every 2 s). Skull swarm rows are separate events with amounts 1/2/4/8/16 at 4:00/4:05/4:15/4:25/4:35. The wiki gives no amount for bat/ghost swarms (generator defaults apply). Pressure plates are not modelled here.

chest_rules.roll_order: 5-item chance first, then 3-item, then 1-item; each chance is multiplied by player Luck; compared to a random 0-100 per roll; fallback_level is the chest tier if all fail.
chest_rules.evo: If an evolution is available, evo-flagged chests can evolve a weapon (generally one per chest); the wiki table's evo flag meaning is inferred from the treasure template.
chest_rules.reward_flags_note: reward1/reward4/reward5 flags exist in the treasure template; their exact meaning is not documented on the pages read (unknown).
chest_rules.wiki_table_parse_note: First-minute-of-stage values: '1:00 ... evo=1' etc. copied verbatim; a blank evo means not evolving.
chest_rules.fractional_chance_note: Minute 3 Giant Mummy chest lists a 0.1% 5-item chance; code that int()s the chance reads it as 0.

reaper.spawn: 15:00 (all on-screen enemies cleared), then one additional Reaper each minute afterwards
reaper.hp_note: multiplied by player level when spawned (HP x Level)
reaper.knockback_note: negative: hits drag it toward the player
reaper.behaviour: Rushes the player and deals 65,535 damage, ending the run. Surviving to the end rewards 500 gold (revive bonuses stack +100 each up to +400). Orologion/other freeze can freeze it per wiki text (wiki lists freeze resistance 1 but the text says freezing is possible - contradictory; Orologion freeze goes through freeze resistance).

light_sources.spawn_chance: 20% base (stage), multiplied by Luck, capped at 60%
light_sources.spawn_location: predetermined possible spawn locations in this stage (Light source page); Mad Forest spawns them in an oval around the player
light_sources.cap_behaviour: when at cap, a new spawn appears nearest the player and the oldest despawns

rosary.effect: kills all enemies (on screen) that are not immune to instant kill; bosses/Reaper resistant

orologion.effect: freezes all enemies for 10 seconds; frozen enemies do not move or damage the player and can be pushed by walking into them; newly spawned enemies also freeze

vacuum.effect: pulls all Experience Gems on the ground to the player; ignores other pickups; takes time to arrive

nduja.effect: player breathes fire in facing direction for 10 s (damage 30, cooldown 0.5s, interval 0.04s per weapon table)
